question: A basketball team makes half its two-point shots. What three-point percentage scores the same per shot, in percent?
move: Compare options by what each attempt is worth, not by how often it succeeds.
trap: Expecting a harder shot to need a similar success rate to pay.
hint: Work out how many points one two-point attempt is worth on average.
steps: A 50% two is worth 0.5 x 2 = 1 point per shot.
A three is worth p x 3 points per shot.
reference: Goldsberry, SprawlBall: A Visual Tour of the New Era of the NBA, Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, 2019
